world.title: 一条迭代公式控制一万个点的运动
world.posterTitle: 参数变化让点云形成周期与混沌运动
world.posterHook: 纯黑画布上，每个点只是 sin 与 cos；合在一起却像深海里一只缓缓呼吸的白影。换系数、拧形变，看它从水母变成脊骨。
world.posterSource: Canvas 2D · 参数点场 · 本地构建
world.question: 一串三角公式，怎么长成一只会游的白影？
world.hook: 每个点只是 sin、cos 和距离；合在一起却像一条发光的脊骨在深海里游过。
world.payoff: 参数方程把时间与索引映射到平面；嵌套的周期函数让形状在闭合与开放之间缓慢变形——这就是「公式粒子」生成艺术的核心。

en.title: One iterative formula controls the motion of ten thousand points
en.posterTitle: Parameter changes produce periodic and chaotic point-cloud motion
en.posterHook: On pure black, each point is only sin and cos; together they look like a white silhouette breathing in the deep. Swap coefficients, turn morph, watch jellyfish become spine.
en.posterSource: Canvas 2D · Parametric point field · Local build
en.question: How do nested trig formulas grow into a swimming white shadow?
en.hook: Each point is only sin, cos, and distance; together they look like a glowing spine drifting through deep water.
en.payoff: Parametric equations map time and index onto the plane; nested periodic functions slowly morph the form between closed and open shapes — the core of formula-particle generative art.

world.title: 铁磁流体
world.posterTitle: 磁铁一靠近，黑色液体为什么长出尖刺？
world.posterHook: 磁铁一靠近，黑色液体就长出尖刺。
world.posterSource: WebGL · 实时液面着色 · 本地构建
world.question: 磁铁一靠近，黑色液体为什么会长出尖刺？
world.hook: 拖着磁铁掠过液面，看镜面般的黑色液体竖起一片尖峰，又在磁铁离开后慢慢融回平滑。
world.payoff: 铁磁流体里悬浮着极小的磁性颗粒。磁场足够强时，它会把液面向上拉；重力和表面张力又想把液面压平，两边相持时便排出一簇簇尖峰。

en.title: Ferrofluid
en.posterTitle: Why does black liquid grow spikes when a magnet comes close?
en.posterHook: Bring a magnet close, and black liquid grows a crown of spikes.
en.posterSource: WebGL · Real-time surface shading · Local build
en.question: Why does black liquid grow spikes when a magnet comes close?
en.hook: Sweep a magnet over the mirror-black surface. A field of peaks rises to follow it, then melts smooth again as the magnet moves away.
en.payoff: Ferrofluid suspends tiny magnetic particles in a liquid. A strong enough field pulls the surface upward while gravity and surface tension pull it flat; their balance organizes the surface into peaks.
